mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM user_reminders AS r INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.status = 'active' AND r.remind_at IS NOT NULL AND r.remind_at <= NOW() AND u.status = 'normal' AND u.role = 'user' ORDER BY r.remind_at ASC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE user_reminders SET status = 'notified' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'active'
